//: Must also be listed in app.security.capabilities in tauri.conf.json. A capability absent from that allow-list is parsed and validated and then never enabled, and every command it grants is refused with 'not allowed by ACL' — which reads as a missing permission rather than a switched-off capability.
description: Lets the app show system notifications: desktop alerts for notifications that arrive while the window is behind others. Granted to the loopback origin the app is served from. Only the three commands the Notification API stand-in uses — ask whether it is allowed, ask for permission, show one — and nothing that reads, cancels or lists what the system is showing.
